verdict.rationale: The Plugins docs index lists a page to 'Implement event subscriptions and webhook delivery for your MCP server,' which suggests the plugin platform has a documented event-subscription and webhook mechanism. The evidence is only a one-line index entry, so it does not show how subscriptions or delivery work. Missing for 10: details on which events can be subscribed to, how subscriptions are registered or managed, webhook payload, signing and retry behavior, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.
